summary: Tested NAMCOS Phase 1 money core (backend + frontend). Backend: all 5 wallet/payment/order endpoints pass (customer OTP login, GET /api/wallet/balance, pay-with-wallet success + INSUFFICIENT short-fall path, order detail, wallet transactions with store name). Direct DB verification confirmed payment record has customer_name & customer_phone (merchant table source). Frontend: shortfall modal renders correctly with Bill/Balance/To-add amounts, wallet history shows Green Mart debit of ₹120, balance correctly reflects ₹380 after wallet pay. Did NOT trigger real Razorpay checkout (LIVE keys).

minor.issue: Uses magic-string error pattern 'INSUFFICIENT|balance|shortfall' as 400 detail — fragile contract between FE/BE. Prefer structured JSON (e.g. {code:'INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS', balance, shortfall}).

Wallet deduction uses $inc without a conditional balance guard inside the update; two concurrent requests could race past the pre-read balance check and overdraw. Use findOneAndUpdate with filter {user_id, balance: {$gte: amount}}.

All seeded stores have owner_id='demo' which is not a real user, so no merchant can see payments end-to-end via OTP login. Cannot run live merchant UI check for /merchant/payments without creating a real merchant user that owns at least one store.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed 'Call Store Support' CTA at bottom-20 (<div className="fixed bottom-20 left-0 right-0 ... pointer-events-none"> with pointer-events-auto on inner full-width child) overlays and intercepts taps on the Payment Method tiles (Wallet in particular) and the Pay button on 390px mobile viewport. Real-user Playwright click on [data-testid='pay-method-wallet'] and [data-testid='pay-now-btn'] was blocked until we removed/scrolled past the overlay. Fix: either make the inner CTA width-fit (not left:0 right:0), or add bottom padding to the pay card so it sits above the sticky CTA, or raise sticky CTA z-index with its own clickable hit area only.

design_issues.screen: Order Detail / Store Detail success card
issues: payMethod capitalize shows 'Wallet' or 'Upi'; 'Upi' should be 'UPI' (uppercase acronym).

action_items: Fix overlay bug: the 'Call Store Support' sticky bar on StoreDetail is covering the Payment Method tiles & Pay button area on mobile — users on small viewports may be unable to tap Wallet / Pay.
Make pay-with-wallet wallet deduction race-safe (atomic conditional update) and return structured error JSON instead of 'INSUFFICIENT|..|..' string.
Seed at least one real merchant user owning a store so merchant portal flows (login + /merchant/payments customer column) can be verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py pay_with_wallet: non-atomic balance check + $inc deduct. Replace with wallet.find_one_and_update({user_id, balance: {$gte: amount}}, {$inc: {balance: -amount}}) and treat None as insufficient.
payments.py: raising HTTPException(400, 'INSUFFICIENT|...') leaks a parsing contract via the error message. Return a proper JSON body with code+amounts.

StoreDetail.jsx: sticky Call CTA uses pointer-events-none outer + pointer-events-auto full-width inner, which still blocks taps on anything underneath across the full page width. Shrink the clickable area to w-max mx-auto, or add pb to Pay card so content isn't under it.
payments.py order_detail / orders.py: ensure /api/orders/{id} returns paid_via='wallet' consistently (confirmed via test).
common.py get_wallet_balance: good — reads real wallet doc, returns 0 default (no hardcoding).

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 executed, 1 skipped due to no real merchant user)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (shortfall modal + wallet history + balance all verified; merchant UI column not verified due to no real merchant user)

All stores are owned by 'demo' (fake user) — merchant portal /merchant/payments UI verification requires creating a real merchant that owns a store. rca_of_overlay_bug:
StoreDetail.jsx lines 258-267: `
...
`. On a 390px mobile viewport the inner div's max-w-[480px] equals full width, so the entire horizontal strip at bottom-20 captures pointer events and blocks any pay-method tile or pay button that scrolls under it. Reproduction: /customer/store/, enter amount, tap 'Wallet' tile — nothing selects. Mitigation: use `w-fit mx-auto` on inner, OR add `pb-32` to the Pay card container so it never sits below the CTA strip.
